changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: The lock table behind every @Scheduled that writes. It lives in the schema of the service, so each service carries its own copy — the provider is configured with the qualified name in application.yml. Columns are TIMESTAMP without a zone on purpose: the provider is set to usingDbTime() and compares them against the clock of the database.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shedlock ( name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lock_until TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, locked_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, locked_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_shedlock PRIMARY KEY (name) );
